subject: Trifecta pilot: makegood credit + extension + discount request
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@trifecta.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trifecta pilot — service interruptions and makegood request

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for hosting the pilot last month. We ran into a couple of platform incidents during peak evaluation windows (attached incident log) that materially affected our ability to finish the benchmark suite — several endpoints timed out and a handful of requests returned incomplete outputs. The engineering team had to re-run portions of the evaluation which pushed our timeline past the original evaluation window.

Given the disruption, Trifecta is asking if Redwood can provide a makegood package so we can complete a thorough assessment before the contract decision. Specifically we are requesting: 1) 200,000 tokens of free credits to cover the re-runs, 2) a 30-day trial extension to finish the remaining benchmarks, and 3) consideration of a 10% promotional discount on first-year committed spend if we convert within 45 days.

Attached is our pilot usage CSV and the incident log for your review. We appreciate flexibility here — we like the product but want to see full results before committing. Our renewal window is narrow (end of May), so a timely response would help.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of AI Engineering, Trifecta Labs
lena@trifecta.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Options I think we can consider (I priced rough back-of-envelope):
- Option A: 150k credits + 21-day extension + 7.5% discount — lower immediate cost, keeps momentum.
- Option B: 250k credits + 30-day extension + 5–7% discount if they sign a 12-month $120k ARR commit — larger upfront concession but increases chance to convert.

Ben — ran the numbers and checked precedent from similar pilot remediations. Key points:
- Cost to Redwood for credits (variable GPU + token cost): approx $0.009/token equivalent given their usage profile. 150k credits ~= $1,350 COGS, 250k ~= $2,250.
- Typical makegood we’ve approved for pilots with infra impact has ranged 100k–200k credits + 14–30 day extensions. Deep discounts (>7%) usually require a commit and finance signoff.
- If we accept Option B with a 12-month minimum commit of $120k ARR we can justify 5–7% promotional discount. 10% would require an elevated exception and would be costly relative to account size.

Recommendation for quick turnaround: authorize 180k credits + 25-day extension now (operational fix) and allow Vivek to sign off up to a capped promotion of 7% with a 12-month commit. If Vivek wants the larger credit bucket (225–250k) we should require legal/finance to record the commitment term in the quote.

I attached a one-page cost breakdown (cost-breakdown.xlsx). If you want I can draft the adjusted quote as soon as Vivek confirms.

—Marissa
